scope: Measured-arc to retail-arc correspondence for the e1-drive power-up slice. Each segment is a monotone chain of committed measured samples projected onto a committed retail .aid racing line. A pickup can only be placed where its retail arc falls inside one of these segments; every other pickup is unsupported.
method: For every measured sample, project it onto every retail route polyline (clamped segment projection, closed routes wrap) and keep the residual distance and retail arc. Split each route into contiguous runs whose residual is at most gateMetres. Unwrap the retail arc across a route closure and take the longest non-decreasing subsequence (monotone chain) of each run. Keep a chain only when it has at least minChainSamples samples, spans at least minChainSpanMetres of measured arc and at least minRetailSpanMetres of retail arc. A run that travels backwards along the retail route collapses to one point and is dropped.
gateRule: gateMetres is the measured band half-width (course.band or course.corridor). It is a placement-consistency gate, not a road-width claim: the placement clamps the retail lateral to +/-band, so a correspondence residual larger than the band would move a pickup further than the band the placement itself declares.
